description: The proving ground: migrate the GatePass/campus_movement route groups from the legacy requireTenantRole hook to a bare authenticate hook + per-route requirePermission, one group at a time (guard → student → hod → admin), each with a before/after auth-regression assertion so the 'no access change' claim is a test; add the catalogue-sync CI meta-test; then run the full build + LIVE smoke test. platform.ts stays requireSuperAdmin and notifications.ts stays bare authenticate (both UNCHANGED). Depends on FEAT-003 (the engine + request.auth). Authoritative = design §7, §8, §9. The compatibility shim (requireRole/requireTenantRole/requireSuperAdmin mapping the legacy enum onto the same ROLE_PERMISSIONS set) keeps any un-flipped surface working at every step; the legacy role claim is NOT removed (later phase).
steps: Flip GUARD routes (c:/campusgate/apps/api/src/routes/guard.ts) FIRST: REPLACE the single top-level `app.addHook('preHandler', requireTenantRole('GUARD'))` with `app.addHook('preHandler', authenticate)` and add per-route { preHandler: [requirePermission('<key>')] } per the design §7 table — POST /guard/verify→campus_movement.gate.verify, /guard/mark-exit→gate.mark_exit, /guard/mark-return→gate.mark_return, GET /guard/lookup+/guard/activity→gate.lookup, POST /guard/shift/start|end + GET /guard/shift/current→shift.manage_own, GET /guard/emergency/active→emergency.view. Record-level getGuardInTenant ownership checks stay unchanged. Add an auth-regression test: a GUARD token still succeeds on /guard/verify and a STUDENT token still 403s.

Flip STUDENT routes (c:/campusgate/apps/api/src/routes/student.ts): replace requireTenantRole('STUDENT') hook with authenticate + per-route requirePermission per §7 — POST /student/gate-pass→pass.request, POST /student/gate-pass/:passId/cancel→pass.cancel, the GET /student/* dashboard/active-pass/history/timeline/summary/reliability/allowance/reasons→pass.view_own, GET /student/emergency/active→emergency.view. Add the before/after regression assertion.

Flip HOD routes (c:/campusgate/apps/api/src/routes/hod.ts): replace requireTenantRole('HOD') with authenticate + per-route requirePermission per §7 — GET /hod/requests* + /hod/stats→pass.view_department, POST /hod/approve→pass.approve, /hod/reject→pass.reject, /hod/revoke→pass.revoke, /hod/emergency-override→pass.override, GET /hod/emergency/active→emergency.view. Add the regression assertion.

Flip ADMIN routes (c:/campusgate/apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts) LAST (largest surface): replace requireTenantRole('ADMIN') with authenticate + per-route requirePermission, completing the admin.* key column against the real admin.ts routes using the design §4 catalogue — /admin/users*→admin.users.*, /admin/students/bulk-import→admin.students.import, /admin/students/export(.xlsx)→admin.students.export, /admin/departments→admin.departments.manage, /admin/gates*→admin.gates.manage, /admin/guard-shifts→admin.shifts.manage, /admin/reasons→admin.reasons.manage, /admin/allowance-policy→admin.allowance_policy.manage, /admin/institution-config→admin.institution_config.manage, /admin/academic-calendar*→admin.academic_calendar.manage, /admin/audit-logs→campus_movement.audit.view, /admin/stats+/admin/analytics→campus_movement.analytics.view, POST /admin/passes/:id/revoke→campus_movement.pass.revoke, /admin/emergency-override→campus_movement.pass.override, /admin/emergency/declare→campus_movement.emergency.declare, /admin/emergency/:id/resolve→campus_movement.emergency.resolve, GET /admin/emergency/active→campus_movement.emergency.view. Add the regression assertion. LEAVE platform.ts (requireSuperAdmin) and notifications.ts (bare authenticate) unchanged.

Add the catalogue-sync CI meta-test (design §3.1 step 2b finding #3, §9): a static-parse test that reads the identity_rbac_b2 migration.sql, extracts its embedded permission keys and (roleKey, permissionKey) pairs, and asserts set-equality against PERMISSIONS + ROLE_PERMISSIONS imported from @campusgate/shared; fail on drift; pin to the migration file by name. Place it under apps/api unit tests (the only vitest runner today) importing @campusgate/shared and reading the migration by relative path.

Run the whole build + test suite and the LIVE smoke test (design §9 / task): apply the migration + seed against live Supabase if not already; start the API (`npm run dev --workspace @campusgate/api`) and verify login per role returns a token with permissions + legacy role; a GUARD token works on /guard/verify and 403s a STUDENT; HOD/ADMIN/STUDENT migrated routes behave as before the flip; SUPER_ADMIN still 403s on a tenant route and 200s on /platform/stats; session revocation still blocks. Confirm User.role/User.institutionId and the legacy role claim all remain. Commit locally on main — NEVER push (the user pushes to GitHub themselves).
acceptance_criteria: Each of guard.ts/student.ts/hod.ts/admin.ts has its single top-level requireTenantRole hook REPLACED by a bare authenticate hook plus per-route requirePermission; platform.ts and notifications.ts are unchanged
For every flipped group an auth-regression test proves the role that holds the key still succeeds and a role that does not still 403s — identical outcomes to the old requireTenantRole
authenticate runs exactly once per request (no double-authenticate); requirePermission performs no second authentication
The catalogue-sync meta-test passes against the FEAT-002 migration and fails on an injected drift
`npm test --workspace @campusgate/api` is fully green including the live escape suite and all auth-regression tests; the LIVE smoke checks pass
User.role, User.institutionId, and the legacy role JWT claim are all still present (removal is a later phase)
verification: From repo root: `npm run build` (turbo) succeeds and `npm run build --workspace @campusgate/api` typechecks clean after each group flip

From apps/api: `npx vitest run` after EACH group flip stays green (run guard, then student, then hod, then admin); final `npm test --workspace @campusgate/api` passes incl. the live escape + catalogue-sync + auth-regression tests

LIVE smoke: with the API running, a login per role yields a token carrying permissions; /guard/verify accepts a GUARD and 403s a STUDENT; /platform/stats 200s for SUPER_ADMIN and tenant routes 403 for SUPER_ADMIN; a revoked session is rejected
findings:
DONE. All four GatePass route groups flipped from the single top-level requireTenantRole hook to a bare top-level `authenticate` hook + per-route requirePermission(key), one group at a time (guard -> student -> hod -> admin), each kept green before moving on. platform.ts (requireSuperAdmin) and notifications.ts (bare authenticate) are UNCHANGED (git status confirms neither file is modified). The B-1 migration and the identity_rbac_b2 migration are untouched. User.role, User.institutionId, and the legacy `role` JWT claim all remain (verified live: every token carries role + permissions[]). The out-of-scope regenerated web artifact apps/web/public/sw.js (from `npm run build`) was reverted.

=== PER-ROUTE FLIP (authoritative §7 table, verified against the real routes) ===
GUARD (apps/api/src/routes/guard.ts): /emergency/active->campus_movement.emergency.view; /shift/current|start|end->campus_movement.shift.manage_own; /verify->gate.verify; /mark-exit->gate.mark_exit; /mark-return->gate.mark_return; /lookup + /activity->gate.lookup.
STUDENT (student.ts): /emergency/active->emergency.view; GET /reasons,/allowance,/dashboard,/active-pass,/history,/gate-pass/:id/timeline,/gate-pass/:id/summary,/reliability->campus_movement.pass.view_own; POST /gate-pass->pass.request; POST /gate-pass/:passId/cancel->pass.cancel.
HOD (hod.ts): /emergency/active->emergency.view; GET /requests,/requests/:id,/requests/:id/reliability,/requests/:id/allowance,/requests/:id/timeline,/requests/:id/summary,/stats->pass.view_department; /approve->pass.approve; /reject->pass.reject; /revoke->pass.revoke; /emergency-override->pass.override.
ADMIN (admin.ts, largest; §4 catalogue): /stats + /analytics->campus_movement.analytics.view; GET /emergency/active + GET /emergency(list)->campus_movement.emergency.view; /emergency/declare->emergency.declare; /emergency/:id/resolve->emergency.resolve; GET /users->admin.users.view; POST /users->admin.users.create; /users/:id/approve->admin.users.approve; /users/:id/deactivate->admin.users.deactivate; /users/:id/reactivate->admin.users.reactivate; /students/bulk-import->admin.students.import; /students/export + /students/export.xlsx->admin.students.export; /departments(GET+POST)->admin.departments.manage; /gates,/gates/health,/gates/:gateId/health,POST /gates->admin.gates.manage; /guard-shifts(GET+POST)->admin.shifts.manage; /reasons(GET+POST)->admin.reasons.manage; /allowance-policy(GET+PUT)->admin.allowance_policy.manage; /institution-config(GET+PUT)->admin.institution_config.manage; /academic-calendar(GET)+/academic-calendar/day(PUT)+/academic-calendar/day/:date(DELETE)->admin.academic_calendar.manage; POST /passes/:passId/revoke->campus_movement.pass.revoke; POST /emergency-override->campus_movement.pass.override; /audit-logs->campus_movement.audit.view. Every admin route now carries a per-route preHandler (grep confirmed none left on the bare `async` signature). Record-level getStudentInTenant/getHodInTenant/getGuardInTenant + department/ownership filters are UNCHANGED.

authenticate runs exactly ONCE per request (single top-level hook; requirePermission is a pure can-check that never re-authenticates — verified by the engine unit tests and the live smoke, which shows no double-auth).

=== TESTS ===
NEW apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/auth-regression.integration.test.ts: one before/after regression group per flip — GUARD reaches /guard/verify & STUDENT 403s; STUDENT reaches /student/reasons & GUARD 403s; HOD reaches /hod/requests & STUDENT 403s; ADMIN reaches /admin/users & HOD 403s. Each asserts the role holding the key still succeeds and a role without it still 403s (identical to the old requireTenantRole outcome).
NEW apps/api/src/services/__tests__/catalogue-sync.test.ts (CI meta-test, no DB, static parse): reads packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261018171747_identity_rbac_b2/migration.sql (pinned by name), extracts the embedded permission keys (from the permissions INSERT ... ON CONFLICT block) and the (roleKey, permissionKey) pairs (from the role_permissions VALUES tuple list, SQL comments stripped), asserts set-equality against PERMISSION_KEYS + ROLE_PERMISSIONS from @campusgate/shared, checks for dangling keys, and includes an injected-drift self-check that fails if a fabricated key were accepted. 39 permission keys + 44 role-permission pairs match exactly.
UPDATED pre-existing route tests (mock fixtures only, no behaviour change): tenant-boundary, emergency-alerts, pass-revocation-summary, admin-config-calendar, analytics, gate-health — their `institutionMembership.findUnique` mock was made role-aware (returns the user's template-role permissions via ROLE_PERMISSIONS) so the flipped requirePermission routes resolve a real key set instead of the old roles:[] (which would now 403). This was REQUIRED because the flip moved the access decision from request.user.role to request.auth.permissions.

=== VERIFICATION (all green) ===
- Per-group: `npx vitest run` kept green after guard, student, hod, admin in turn.
- `npm run build --workspace @campusgate/api` typechecks clean (tsc exit 0) after the flips.
- `npm run build` (turbo) full monorepo: 3/3 workspaces successful.
- `npm test --workspace @campusgate/api`: 17 files / 142 tests PASS, including the live cross-tenant escape suite + catalogue-sync + the auth-regression groups.
- LIVE smoke (API on :4000, live Supabase, demo users): 23/23 checks PASS. Login per role returns a token carrying permissions[] + the legacy role (perm counts SUPER_ADMIN=7, ADMIN=21, HOD=6, GUARD=6, STUDENT=4). GUARD->POST /guard/verify 200 while STUDENT 403; STUDENT->/student/reasons 200 while GUARD 403; HOD->/hod/requests 200 while STUDENT 403; ADMIN->/admin/users 200 while HOD 403; SUPER_ADMIN 403 on /admin/users and 200 on /platform/stats (ADMIN 403 on /platform/stats); session revocation: a STUDENT token works pre-logout (200) and is rejected post-logout (401). Server stopped and all temp smoke files removed afterward.

NOTE (pre-existing, NOT FEAT-004): src/services/__tests__/reliability-engine.property.test.ts has a flaky floating-point boundary case ('improvement is exactly 0.5') that intermittently fails under fast-check random seeds; it passes on isolated re-run and in the final full-suite run (142/142). It is unrelated to the auth flip (no permission/auth involvement) and was left untouched.

=== FEAT-005 / later-phase handoff ===
The legacy `role` claim + requireRole/requireTenantRole/requireSuperAdmin shim are still in place and still work (nothing un-flipped relies on them now except platform.ts via requireSuperAdmin and the legacy claim in the token). Removing the legacy role claim is a later phase and requires that NO route reads request.user.role; today platform.ts still uses requireSuperAdmin (which reads request.user.role), so the claim MUST stay for Phase 0.
